assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: original automotive systems navigation illustration for a Brazilian automotive legislation web app. Primary request: produce one polished high-resolution wide landscape automotive parts-catalog illustration: a generic unbranded compact SUV in a logically organized exploded 3/4 isometric view, front at lower left and rear at upper right. Style: professional grayscale workshop catalog, crisp thin dark-gray outlines, detailed restrained shaded gray components, plain pure white background, no decorative effects. This must look like a real technical catalog illustration rather than simple geometric icons. Show clearly separated recognisable system assemblies with generous white space between them: uppermost roof panel, upper-right body shell and detached doors, separate windshield/glass, seats/interior beneath roof, front-left separated hood and bumper with headlamps, detailed combustion engine and transmission ahead of cabin, radiator in front, exhaust pipe along center chassis toward rear, front and rear suspension/steering assemblies, two detached near-side wheels with brake discs/calipers visible, compact battery and wiring assembly near engine, mirror next to body. Keep common coherent perspective and plausible automotive architecture. Make system silhouettes visually distinct so clickable polygon overlays can be drawn afterward. Composition: centered complete vehicle occupies 85 percent of canvas with margins, no cropping, no overlapping the engine with the radiator, restrained exploded spacing, no excessive tiny scattered hardware. No labels, no letters, no numbers, no callout lines, no red highlights, no UI, no borders, no watermark, no manufacturer logos. Original generic educational illustration, not an exact specific vehicle or engineering assembly instruction.
